summary: Enable SIEM-ready audit export beta via tenant allowlist + validate RBAC and destination config (Helio Health)
description:
Request
- Please enable the SIEM-ready audit export beta feature flag for Helio Health and confirm they can create destinations in Console.

Requester / approvals
- Requester: Liam O'Rourke (TAM)
- PM approval: Naomi Feldman (per email + weekly beta check-in)
- Security aware: Marcus Lin (no additional approval needed for allowlist; follow standard PII constraints)

Tenant details
- Customer: Helio Health
- Deployment/tier: enterprise (Hosted + Dedicated mix; beta is hosted/dedicated only)
- Region: us-east
- Tenant: helio-health-prod
- Tenant ID: tnt_7c2f1f9d (from customer record / admin console)
- Primary workspace: ws_01HSHK9G4Y9KZ7

Enablement scope
1) Add tenant to SIEM Audit Export beta allowlist (kill switch remains off).
2) Validate RBAC:
   - Enterprise Admins can: create/update/delete export configs, rotate credentials refs, pause/resume exports.
   - Auditors can: view delivery status/health but cannot edit configs.
3) Confirm destination configuration succeeds:
   - Datadog Logs intake (US site)
   - S3 delivery (customer-managed bucket)
   - (Optional later) Splunk HEC (not required for Helio; they are Datadog + S3)
4) Confirm exporter status endpoint reports healthy and events begin flowing.

Notes / constraints to keep in mind
- Delivery is at-least-once; customer must deduplicate using event_id.
- Backfill window for beta: 7 days max (customer asked about 30 days; we should reiterate limitation).
- PII: do not include raw prompt/response content in audit exports; adhere to schema v2 + redaction policy.

Operational checks requested
- Verify exporter metrics on dashboard show lag < 5m for this tenant within 30 minutes of enabling.
- If destination errors (403/429), do NOT disable flag; pause the export config and coordinate credential fix.

Customer timeline
- They want to validate in their Datadog within 24 hours to keep procurement/security review moving.

Artifacts
- Customer context: Helio Health SIEM beta (Datadog + S3). Prior 403 on Datadog key scoping tracked in SUP-18497.
- Follow-up likely: credential rotation ticket (if needed) should be filed as separate INT issue.

resolution: Completed enablement for Helio Health (tenant tnt_7c2f1f9d) by adding tenant to SIEM audit export beta allowlist in prod/us-east. Validated RBAC (enterprise_admin can manage export configs; security_auditor can only view status). Confirmed export configuration page is available in Console and exporter status endpoint returns healthy. S3 destination validated end-to-end; Datadog destination showed intermittent 403 due to customer key scoping (tracked separately in SUP-18497).
next_steps: TAM to coordinate Datadog API key scope fix/rotation with customer (see SUP-18497).
If Datadog token rotation requires Redwood-side secret ref update assistance, file a separate INT ticket (similar to INT-9077 flow).
Monitor exporter dashboard for tenant for 48 hours post-enablement; page only if lag breaches SLO window per runbook.
